jdm-legends.title: Japanese JDM Legends
jdm-legends.description: Rotaries, twin-turbo straight-sixes and rally weapons: from the AE86 drifting down a mountain pass to the Supra that launched a thousand posters.

american-muscle.title: American Muscle & Classics
american-muscle.description: Big-block V8s, long bonnets and burnouts at the lights. From the Model T that put America on wheels to the Viper that tried to bite back.

autobahn-heroes.title: German Autobahn Heroes
autobahn-heroes.description: Built for the derestricted stretch where the white sign with the black stripes means flat out. Quattro grip, M power and Stuttgart flat-sixes.

italian-exotics.title: Italian Exotics
italian-exotics.description: Prancing horses, raging bulls and a trident: pure drama on wheels. Find the 308 GTSi a certain private investigator drove around Hawaii.

british-icons.title: British Icons
british-icons.description: From the Mini to the DB5: tweed, torque and a stiff upper lip. Expect hand-built engines, green paint and a little bit of drizzle.

hot-hatch-heroes.title: Hot Hatch Heroes
hot-hatch-heroes.description: Small cars, big grins. The pocket rockets that rule every B-road, from the 205 GTI to a Yaris that was built to win rallies.

electric-era.title: Electric Era
electric-era.description: Silent, instant and seriously quick. The cars that pulled the plug on petrol, from the little i3 to a Croatian hypercar with four motors.

hypercar-hall-of-fame.title: Hypercar Hall of Fame
hypercar-hall-of-fame.description: The fastest, rarest and wildest machines ever to wear a number plate. Spot one and the whole car park turns its head.

fun_facts.ferrari-308-gtsi: The fuel-injected targa that Thomas Magnum drove in Magnum, P.I.: the "i" in GTSi stands for injection.
